shops.name: Bliss Matcha & Beyond (West Hartford)

shops.name: Bliss Matcha & Beyond (New Haven)
shops.notes: Not a Yelp lead: the second shop on the same own site. The site prints hours for Sun, Mon and Sat only, so hours are left null.

shops.name: Matchaful (Brookfield Place)
shops.notes: Own cafes page lists Brookfield Place at 250 Vesey Street (inside Clean Market). It lists no 230 Vesey St cafe, which is what the lead said.

shops.name: Tokuyamatcha & Onigirazu Bar
shops.notes: Held: its only page is the footer of a hair-salon site; another worker found conflicting addresses and no bar page. Own cafe page lists three locations (also 627 E 6th St and 28 Grand St, not added) and 10am-6pm hours for all, not day by day.

shops.notes: Own contacts page. A search result said it shares the address with the Maison la Fleur cafe; that page was not read.
